svg.title: Spirit of Αἰθήρ: The Foolish Man (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Above, Air, the Key's attribution; below, the letter Aleph (א); Key 0, Path 11. Its ring: number 57 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791650836504-7c4fhshb1qa.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
